digest.title: OpenAI safety employee resigns, claiming the company’s ‘culture is broken’
digest.tldr: By his own admission, David Robinson is “something of a cliché”: an employee at a leading AI company who issues a dire warning while resigning from their job.

digest.title: Milt Windler, NASA flight director who helped save Apollo 13, dies at 94
An OpenAI safety employee has quit and is sounding the alarm
digest.tldr: David Robinson used to write the safety reports that accompanied every major model release at OpenAI.  This week, he resigned from his position and is now speaking out in an editorial in The Atlantic.

digest.title: Amazon responds to data center backlash, says it no longer uses NDAs
digest.tldr: The CEO of Amazon Web Services tried to push back against widespread suspicion of data centers.

digest.title: ShinyHunters hacker reportedly detained in Jordan, aiding FBI
digest.tldr: A suspected ShinyHunters hacking group member known online as "Rey" has reportedly been detained in Jordan and is cooperating with the FBI to help locate other members of the extortion group.
